sections.heading: C2 — KG hints for Intersections, Emergency Vehicles, School Buses
sections.markdown:
## C2 — KG hints for Intersections, Emergency Vehicles, School Buses

FACT_ID: sec06-R01 | anchor: A01
The rapid-flashing beacon answers a button with strobing amber at signal-free crossings, while the hybrid beacon answers a walker with a yellow-to-red lamp ladder [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint ped-beacons; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec06-F01 and sec06-F03.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec06-R02 | anchor: A01
A dark hybrid beacon invites careful passage, while steady twin reds on the same beacon command a stop for pedestrians [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint ped-beacons; prereq_hint sec06-F03; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec06-F03 and sec06-F04.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec06-R03 | anchor: A01
Under strobing amber you stay stopped for crosswalk users, while under blinking twin reds you stop once and may roll on through an empty crossing [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint ped-beacons; prereq_hint sec06-F02; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec06-F02 and sec06-F04.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec06-R04 | anchor: A01
Yield rules name who waits but award the right-of-way to no one, while the crash-avoidance duty binds even whoever holds it [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint row-concept; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec06-F06 and sec06-F07.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec06-R05 | anchor: A01
Cyclists carry the same road rights as drivers, yet draw extra yielding because they crash unprotected [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint vulnerable-users; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec06-F05 and sec06-F08.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec06-R06 | anchor: A02
Right on red needs only a stop and a yield unless a sign bans it, while a left turn must wait out straight-bound oncoming cars [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint turn-yield; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec06-F10 and sec06-F13.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec06-R07 | anchor: A02
First to the all-way stop leaves first, while simultaneous arrivals send the rightmost car first [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint all-way-stop; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec06-F14.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec06-R08 | anchor: A02
Entering the road you yield to rolling traffic, while crossing the sidewalk you yield to people on foot [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint entering-yield; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec06-F11 and sec06-F15.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec06-R09 | anchor: A02
Open road means ease right for the rig at once, while sitting inside an intersection means drive through it before pulling aside [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint emergency-drill; prereq_hint sec06-F17; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec06-F18 and sec06-F19.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec06-R10 | anchor: A02
Across a median divider you need not stop for the rig at all, while trailing one you must keep 500 feet back [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint emergency-drill; prereq_hint sec06-F17; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec06-F19 and sec06-F20.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec06-R11 | anchor: A02
Signed intersections spell the rules out, while unsigned ones bind the same rules plus extra caution [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint uncontrolled; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec06-F21.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec06-R12 | anchor: A03
From behind, flashing bus lamps forbid passing outright, while from ahead amber lamps only slow you to no more than 20 mph [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint bus-approach; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec06-F22 and sec06-F24.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec06-R13 | anchor: A03
Facing the armed bus on a narrow road you must halt ahead of it, while facing it across a wide road you may roll past [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint bus-meeting; prereq_hint sec06-F25; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec06-F25 and sec06-F28.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec06-R14 | anchor: A03
From behind on a wide road you stop and wait like on a narrow one, while from ahead across the lanes you are released [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint bus-meeting; prereq_hint sec06-F23; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec06-F27 and sec06-F28.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec06-R15 | anchor: A03
The halted bus demands 15 feet of queue space behind it, while a violation can suspend your license for up to 180 days [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint bus-penalty; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec06-F23 and sec06-F26.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0020]
